native_config:
version: "1.0.0"
title: "Independent change review"
description: "Read-only adversarial review of a frozen diff and its tests"
instructions: |
  You review a change you did not write. Read the diff and the test output supplied as parameters.
  Do not edit files. List findings with file, line, evidence and a reproduction command.
  If you find nothing, say what you checked.
prompt: "Review the change described in the parameters."
extensions: []
settings:
  goose_provider: "openai"
  goose_model: "qwen3.8-max"
  temperature: 0.2
  max_turns: 30
parameters: []
sub_recipes: []
response:
  json_schema:
    type: object
    properties:
      findings:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            file:
              type: string
            line:
              type: integer
            evidence:
              type: string
            repro:
              type: string
      checked:
        type: string
    required:
      - findings
      - checked
retry:
  max_retries: 2
  timeout_seconds: 60
  checks: []
  on_failure: "echo review failed"
invocation: goose run --recipe review.recipe.yaml with the frozen diff supplied as input; set GOOSE_MODE to an approval mode that blocks file edits
limitations: Recipe fields match the recipe reference. Using provider `openai` with a Qwen model needs a custom base URL, which was not documented on the fetched pages.
Permission modes are auto, smart_approve, approve and chat. The page gave no allowlist syntax, so tool restriction is not shown here.
Subagents run at most 25 turns and cannot nest.
The `retry.checks` list is empty here; the docs example uses a shell check.
No install, load or dry-run was executed.
role_binding: The default independent reviewer for omo-authored work (momus seat in the matrix) and an author for CI-shaped rows A04, A08 and A10.

profiles.ultimate: Reviewer model chain qwen3.8-max > qwen3.7-plus on code rows; deepseek-v4-pro > kimi-k3 on general rows.
